x: Adam Zawadski, back after missing the season through injury, gained maximum B string points in the 800m. Then last year's top points scorer Graham Beasley ran one of his fastest 100 metres of the season followed by an equally impressive B string win in the 200m.

Top right: A new name in the Belgrave road squad - Adam Zawadski. An international on the track at 1500m, Adam had to run a time trial to get into the team and then ran 6th fastest short stage of the day to take the "claret and gold" to the tape.
